breakdown.description: In a spontaneous Zn/Cu galvanic cell, Zn is the anode and Cu is the cathode.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly identifies Zn as the anode (oxidation) and Cu as the cathode (reduction), explicitly stating that labeling Cu as the anode and Zn as the cathode is incorrect. This directly resolves the inconsistency where the incomplete prompt had the electrodes reversed.
